verdict.rationale: Base44 is documented as an AI app builder where you describe your idea and the AI builds the app (base44-docs-31, base44-probe-1), and the resulting apps include both frontend code and backend resources (base44-docs-22, base44-docs-17). Community users report getting fully functional apps from one or two prompts, with the database built into the platform (base44-comm-2, base44-comm-5, base44-comm-6). One user says complex apps can hit a wall beyond a single prompt (base44-comm-8). missing for 10: explicit first-party docs that backend logic (functions, data models, auth rules) is generated from the same single prompt as the UI, and hands-on evidence of non-trivial backend logic produced in one prompt.
